argv:
set -eu
echo '@@ BOOT'; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME'; date -u +%s; cat /proc/uptime
echo '@@ AVOC'; pidof avocd; p=$(pidof avocd); readlink -f /proc/$p/exe; cat /proc/$p/stat
echo '@@ DEVICED'; pidof deviced; p=$(pidof deviced); readlink -f /proc/$p/exe; cat /proc/$p/stat
echo '@@ TRACE'; cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/current_tracer
echo '@@ COMPLETE'
